description: This file defines the MonkeyPowerEvent class, which extends MonkeyEvent and facilitates logging and managing power-related events during Android testing. It includes methods for buffering events, writing logs to a file, and handling specific power test sequences.

classes.name: MonkeyPowerEvent
classes.description: Handles power-related testing events, logs, and sequence management for Android testing frameworks.

methods.name: MonkeyPowerEvent
methods.description: Constructs a MonkeyPowerEvent with specified power log tag and test result.

methods.name: bufferLogEvent
methods.description: Buffers a power test event with timestamp and optional value for later writing to log.

methods.name: writeLogEvents
methods.description: Outputs accumulated log events to a log file on external storage.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Injects the power event into system, logging or writing data based on current state.
